visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontal promo banner: framed screenshot next to a short text and CTA
visualCharacteristics.layout: two columns side by side on desktop, stacked on mobile; image column wrapped in a frame hook for the decorative monitor
visualCharacteristics.notes: used in a section with style 'dark-gradient'; the monitor frame is decorative and is not authored

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: image; cell 2: text paragraph and CTA link (bold = primary button)

reuseGuidance: Use for a single image + text promotional band. For generic multi-column layouts use columns.
